A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GigaSpeech 2 study and provide readable text, figures, tables, algorithms, and appendices. Relocated and renumbered material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: Sections 4.1–4.4 and Appendix D report original ASR evaluations, corpus comparisons, and NST ablations, including Tables 2–5 and 8.

after.justification: The original ASR experiments and ablations remain, with additional processing-time measurements and Whisper Medium evaluations in Tables 6 and 10.

M1.justification: The transcription, alignment, filtering, and modified NST procedures remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 moves from the appendix into Section 3.2 without substantive alteration. The abstract's change from TorchAudio to MMS identifies the same alignment checkpoint documented in both versions.

E1.justification: The evaluated languages and datasets remain Thai, Indonesian, and Vietnamese using GigaSpeech 2, YODAS, Common Voice, and FLEURS. Added evaluations reuse existing Thai coverage. Malay, Korean, Minnan, and Arabic appear only as expansion plans.

E2.justification: Appendix D/Table 10 adds a comparison between Whisper Medium and its GigaSpeech 2 Thai fine-tuned checkpoint. The existing Whisper, MMS, commercial-service, YODAS, and toolkit comparisons retain their comparator membership.

E3.justification: The new timing evaluation uses a 100-hour Thai subset on an idle machine with one V100 32G GPU. Appendix D also evaluates additional Whisper model configurations on existing Thai tests. Existing splits, metrics, and Zipformer/Conformer training configurations remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix A.4/Table 6 adds a stage-by-stage analysis of corpus-processing cost. The relabeling and augmentation ablation in Table 8, together with the corpus-distribution analyses, is retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions disclose seed 42 for Zipformer and report point estimates without confidence intervals, variance estimates, or significance tests. The Google USM repeated-testing note is retained; no new run-count or uncertainty-reporting procedure appears.

E6.justification: Table 5 revises ESPnet's Vietnamese WER from 15.60 to 14.60 without describing a setting change. New Table 10 reports Whisper Medium/fine-tuned CERs of 37.55/14.15 on GigaSpeech 2 and 16.41/6.92 on Common Voice. Table 6 adds processing-time results; Tables 2–4 and the existing ablation scores remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Algorithm 1 retains the same mathematical conditions and updates despite relocation and reformatting. No new mathematical definitions, formal assumptions, theoretical results, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the approximately 30,000-hour, three-language corpus contribution, automated refinement pipeline, challenging evaluation sets, and claimed 25–40% error reduction with roughly one-tenth of Whisper large-v3's parameters. The added evaluations support existing claims.

C2.justification: v2 qualifies channel separation as reducing the likelihood of speaker overlap and acknowledges unequal data volumes in the YODAS comparison. Its limitations omit v1's explanation for not using language-model fusion and replace plans to enlarge Indonesian/Vietnamese data with named language-expansion plans.

D1.justification: Appendix A newly documents full manual inspection, 30% secondary rechecking, a greater-than-97% accuracy acceptance criterion, and video-level domain annotation. v2 also adds Creative Commons provenance and anonymization disclosures, timing information, and checkpoint links. The conclusion changes resource release from forthcoming to reported as completed.

R1.justification: NST positioning expands through added citations to Xu et al. (2020), Likhomanenko et al. (2021), and Mehmood et al. (2022), plus discussion of Chen et al.'s CER-based selection. The HuBERT reference is removed. The overall research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: v2 refines wording and terminology, expands the NST explanation, updates affiliations, and adopts author-year citations. Algorithm 1 moves into the main text, limitations follow the conclusion, and an Ethics Statement is added. Most of the narrative and section organization is retained.

P2.justification: The document switches throughout from single-column to two-column layout. Appendix figures and configuration tables are substantially reduced in display size, Algorithm 1 is relocated, and new timing and Whisper-result tables are added. Table 8 also removes its redundant training-hours column.

improvement.justification: v2 documents transcription quality controls and processing cost, adds a useful but narrow Whisper Medium fine-tuning evaluation, and clarifies reported resource release. These improve transparency and usability while leaving the central evidence largely unchanged. Smaller appendix displays and removal of the language-model-fusion limitation are modest drawbacks, leaving a limited net improvement.
